quote: Open year round with limited services in the winter.
remark: Seasons of Use line; page also says 'Other sites are available on a first-come, first-served basis.' Calendar 'closes 10-11' is the end of reservations.

Forest's '2026 Recreation Opening Dates' list under Lake Sherwood Recreation Area: West Shore Loop 4/17; Meadow Creek, Cales Knoll and Pine Run single-site loops 5/18 (near the chip's 05-24). West Shore is the non-reservable spring/fall loop, so the calendar edge is the reservation start. Year-specific (2026). No closing date stated by the agency (the FS campground page and rec.gov text give no season).
Seasons of Use line. Active Tracy Run Wildfire alert (Nov 4, 2026, 100% contained) lists only Tracy Ridge Area Trails and the NCT as affected, not the campground.
